card.name: Punctuation right before an all-caps heading
card.fires_on: Punctuation such as a period or closing parenthesis that ends a sentence or entry, just before the next sentence or heading starts in ALL CAPS. Also fires inside all-caps warning text.

modes.label: Break before caps heading
modes.description: A period or closing bracket ends a line and the next heading or title is in capital letters.

modes.label: Inside all-caps warning text
modes.description: Marks or word endings within capitalized boxed-warning text.
